title: Benedict Gross and Epstein proposal for evolutionary dynamics at Harvard

tellings.quote: and Harvard references an imaginative proposal by Benedict Gross and Jeffrey Epstein.

plain: Eric Weinstein, a mathematician and commentator, points to a Harvard University record from the 2000s that, he says, mentions "an imaginative proposal by Benedict Gross and Jeffrey Epstein," Gross being a Harvard mathematician and Epstein the financier. Weinstein ties this to the founding of a Harvard programme in evolutionary dynamics, the mathematical study of how evolution works, linked to the biologist Martin Nowak. He raises it to suggest that Epstein had a hand in steering elite science, which would matter if such money shaped what gets studied.
